turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, how's your day been so far?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm a teacher trying to move into UX design and I have an interview next week.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Big switch, and teaching is great background for it. Do you want to lead with your classroom skills, or open with the portfolio projects you've done?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Wait a moment, my coworker is here. Please be quiet until I tell you I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can you taste this sauce? Is it too salty?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Hmm, a little bit. Not terrible though.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ugh, I knew it. I added the stock and forgot it was already salted.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Just throw in some more tomatoes, that usually fixes it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Good idea. Do you know if we have another tin?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Back again, Moshi. Could you carry on?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. Your UX interview. Starting with teaching, or with the portfolio?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Right, next thing. My dad was just diagnosed with diabetes and he's gutted he can't have my lemon cake anymore.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's tough. He might not have to give it up completely, but it's worth checking with his doctor about portions.
